acquisition method: A top ten data-dependent acquisition MS method was used.
alkylation reagent: Samples were alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature for 30 min
alkylation concentration: Samples were alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature for 30 min
cleavage agent: Samples were digested to peptides using trypsin/Lys-C
enrichment method: Phospho-samples were further enriched by TiO2 phosphopeptide enrichment kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
instrument: Easy-nLC 1200-Orbitrap Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer
Nano-electrospray ionization-LC-MS/MS analyses were performed using an Easy-nLC 1200-Orbitrap Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: Kinase reactions then occurred on the filter with the addition of 400 ng of murine FLAG-Mast2 (294–1197) in the presence of 1 mM [γ-18O4]-ATP
precursor tolerance: Processing parameters included trypsin (full) as enzyme, 10 ppm precursor mass tolerance
fragment tolerance: 10 ppm precursor mass tolerance, 20 ppm fragment mass tolerance
ptm: variable phosphorylated amino acids (+79.966331 Da for S, T, Y); variable 18O3-replaced phosphorylated amino acids (+85.97907 Da for S, T, Y); fixed alkylated cysteine residues (+57.021465 Da)

Processing parameters included trypsin (full) as enzyme, 10 ppm precursor mass tolerance, 20 ppm fragment mass tolerance, 1% protein false discovery rate, variable (common) modification of phosphorylated amino acids (+79.966331 Da for S, T, Y) and 18O3-replaced phosphorylated amino acids (+85.97907 Da for S, T, Y), and fixed modification (+57.021465 Da for alkylated cysteine residues).
reduction reagent: Reactions were quenched by adding 8 M Urea and 5 mM DTT
reduction concentration: Reactions were quenched by adding 8 M Urea and 5 mM DTT
